counts.sql: SELECT count(*),count(rsrp) rsrp,count(sinr) sinr,count(cqi) cqi FROM task_sample WHERE task_id IN (SELECT id FROM task_run WHERE project_id=:pid)

status.sql: SELECT status,reason,count(*) n FROM task_run WHERE project_id=:pid GROUP BY status,reason ORDER BY status,reason

gaps.sql: SELECT percentile_cont(ARRAY[.5,.9]) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY s.seq_gap) all_radio,percentile_cont(ARRAY[.5,.9]) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY s.seq_gap) FILTER(WHERE s.rsrp IS NOT NULL) rsrp FROM task_sample s JOIN task_run t ON t.id=s.task_id WHERE t.project_id=:pid

previous_rsrp.sql: SELECT percentile_cont(ARRAY[.5,.9]) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY s.seq-m.seq) gaps FROM task_sample s JOIN task_run t ON t.id=s.task_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT seq FROM measurement_points WHERE project_id=t.project_id AND capture_id=t.capture_id AND seq<s.seq AND rsrp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true WHERE t.project_id=:pid

threads.sql: SELECT threads FROM task_run WHERE project_id=:pid AND capture_id=:cap AND seq_start=:start
